units.source_text: 从又黑又旧的楼梯上二楼的时候，我又想起有为子的事。

en.t: As I went up the dark, old stairs to the second floor, I thought of Uiko again.

units.source_text: 我在思想：她不在这个时间里，她不在这个时间里的世界。

en.t: I was thinking: she was not in this time; she was not in the world of this time.

units.source_text: 此刻既然她不在，无论上哪儿去寻找，肯定都不会找到她的。

en.t: Since she was not here at this moment, no matter where I went to look, I would surely never find her.

units.source_text: 她像是到我们的世界以外的澡塘入浴去了。

en.t: It was as though she had gone to bathe in a bathhouse outside our world.
